mapper.select: select id from employee where sys_user_id = #{userId} and delmark = 1 limit 1

select r.id as registrationId, r.case_number as caseNumber, r.real_name as patientName, r.gender, r.age, r.age_type as ageType, r.card_number as cardNumber, r.home_address as homeAddress, r.noon, r.visit_state as visitState, date_format(r.visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as visitDate, d.dept_name as departmentName, sc.settle_name as settlementName, mr.allergy, mr.diagnosis from register r join department d on d.id = r.deptment_id join settle_category sc on sc.id = r.settle_category_id left join medical_record mr on mr.register_id = r.id where r.employee_id = #{employeeId} and r.visit_state in (1, 2, 3)
and r.visit_state in (1, 2) and r.visit_state = 3
and (r.real_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.case_number like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.card_number like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by r.visit_date desc, field(r.visit_state, 2, 1, 3), r.id
select count(*) from register where id = #{registrationId} and employee_id = #{employeeId} and visit_state in (1, 2, 3)
select count(*) from register where id = #{registrationId} and employee_id = #{employeeId} and visit_state = 2
mapper.update: update register set visit_state = 2 where id = #{registrationId} and employee_id = #{employeeId} and visit_state = 1
mapper.select: select mr.id, mr.register_id as registrationId, mr.readme, mr.present, mr.present_treat as presentTreat, mr.history, mr.allergy, mr.physique, mr.proposal, mr.careful, mr.diagnosis, mr.cure, group_concat(mrd.disease_id order by mrd.disease_id) as diseaseIds from medical_record mr left join medical_record_disease mrd on mrd.medical_record_id = mr.id where mr.register_id = #{registrationId} group by mr.id
mapper.insert: insert into medical_record(register_id, readme, present, present_treat, history, allergy, physique, proposal, careful) values(#{registrationId}, #{readme}, #{present}, #{presentTreat}, #{history}, #{allergy}, #{physique}, #{proposal}, #{careful}) on duplicate key update readme = values(readme), present = values(present), present_treat = values(present_treat), history = values(history), allergy = values(allergy), physique = values(physique), proposal = values(proposal), careful = values(careful)
mapper.select: select id from medical_record where register_id = #{registrationId}

choose.when:
select d.id, d.drug_code as code, d.drug_name as name, d.drug_format as format, d.drug_unit as unit, d.drug_price as price, d.manufacturer, coalesce(s.on_hand, 0) as stock from drug_info d left join drug_stock s on s.drug_id = d.id
where d.drug_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.drug_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.mnemonic_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by d.drug_code

select id, disease_code as code, disease_name as name, diseaseICD as format, disease_category as category from disease
where disease_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or disease_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or diseaseICD like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by disease_code

mapper.insert: insert into ${tableName}(register_id, medical_technology_id, ${fieldPrefix}_info, ${fieldPrefix}_position, ${fieldPrefix}_remark, created_by, unit_price, request_key, request_hash, line_no) select #{registrationId}, mt.id, #{info}, #{position}, #{remark}, #{employeeId}, mt.tech_price, #{requestKey}, #{requestHash}, #{lineNo} from medical_technology mt where mt.id = #{medicalTechnologyId} and mt.tech_type = #{techType}
mapper.update: update ${tableName} set ${stateField} = 'CANCELLED' where id = #{id} and created_by = #{employeeId} and ${stateField} = 'UNPAID'
mapper.select: select 'check' as type, cr.id, mt.tech_code as itemCode, mt.tech_name as itemName, cr.check_state as status, cr.check_result as result, executor.realname as executor, date_format(cr.check_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as executedAt from check_request cr join medical_technology mt on mt.id = cr.medical_technology_id left join employee executor on executor.id = cr.check_employee_id where cr.register_id = #{registrationId} union all select 'inspection', ir.id, mt.tech_code, mt.tech_name, ir.inspection_state, ir.inspection_result, executor.realname, date_format(ir.inspection_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') from inspection_request ir join medical_technology mt on mt.id = ir.medical_technology_id left join employee executor on executor.id = ir.inspection_employee_id where ir.register_id = #{registrationId} order by id desc
mapper.update: update medical_record set diagnosis = #{diagnosis}, cure = #{cure} where register_id = #{registrationId}
mapper.insert: insert into medical_record_disease(medical_record_id, disease_id) select #{medicalRecordId}, id from disease where id = #{diseaseId}
mapper.update: update register r set r.visit_state = 3 where r.id = #{registrationId} and r.employee_id = #{employeeId} and r.visit_state = 2 and exists(select 1 from medical_record mr where mr.register_id = r.id and mr.diagnosis is not null and char_length(trim(mr.diagnosis)) > 0)
mapper.select: select 'CHECK' as type, cr.id, mt.tech_name as itemName, 1 as quantity, cr.unit_price as unitPrice, cr.unit_price as amount, cr.check_state as status, date_format(cr.creation_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt from check_request cr join medical_technology mt on mt.id = cr.medical_technology_id where cr.register_id = #{registrationId} union all select 'INSPECTION', ir.id, mt.tech_name, 1, ir.unit_price, ir.unit_price, ir.inspection_state, date_format(ir.creation_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') from inspection_request ir join medical_technology mt on mt.id = ir.medical_technology_id where ir.register_id = #{registrationId} union all select 'DISPOSAL', dr.id, mt.tech_name, 1, dr.unit_price, dr.unit_price, dr.disposal_state, date_format(dr.creation_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') from disposal_request dr join medical_technology mt on mt.id = dr.medical_technology_id where dr.register_id = #{registrationId} union all select 'PRESCRIPTION', p.id, d.drug_name, p.drug_number, p.unit_price, round(p.drug_number * p.unit_price, 2), p.drug_state, date_format(p.creation_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') from prescription p join drug_info d on d.id = p.drug_id where p.register_id = #{registrationId} order by createdAt desc, id desc
